grain: ONE ROW PER METHOD VERSION. Not per day, not per account, not per firm: the row describes the arithmetic, and a change to the arithmetic is a new method_version.

columns.name: method_version
columns.meaning: the immutable version of the METHOD this row describes; every account_return_daily row's method_version points here

columns.name: method
columns.meaning: the arithmetic family actually implemented

columns.name: flow_convention
columns.meaning: when a flow is recognised within the day; END is what the producer COMPUTES (DB-b-3 may evaluate others, which is a different fact)

columns.name: income_basis
columns.meaning: when income enters the numerator

columns.name: value_basis
columns.meaning: the account value V_t the return arithmetic divides by, stated as data; method_version 2 is EQUITY = net_mv_plus_cash + margin_balance (1.0.0_SA_CTO RULINGS batch 193). A reader cannot otherwise tell a version-2 return from a version-1 return that read net_mv_plus_cash alone

columns.name: value_basis_ruling

columns.name: fee_basis
columns.meaning: whether the return is gross or net of advisory fees; GROSS_ONLY, and the arithmetic achieves it by admitting FEE-MANAGEMENT legs to F_t as capital out so V_t - F_t adds the fee back (amendment 5 (d))

columns.name: tieout_tolerance_proposed
columns.meaning: the tie-out tolerance DB-b-3 PROPOSES, never one it ratifies. Null in 0.1.0 because DB-b-1 had no basis to assert a number; 0.037 now, measured by DB-b-3 as the preferred convention's p90 rounded up to the next 5 bp. STILL NULLABLE: a future method_version is emitted before its tie-out has run, so the column must be able to say 'not yet proposed'. READ THE MEASUREMENT RECORD BEFORE USING THE VALUE -- row IRPT_DASHBD-S10 and the record's own `sentence` field say this cell recommends AGAINST adopting it as a bar, because the difference it is a percentile of is dominated by the account-days Opal withheld and Black Diamond counted. NULL ONLY UNDER THE CLAIM `absent`: a null value is legal only when tieout_tolerance_proposed_claim says absent, and a non-null value never carries absent (the producer refuses both). emit_method_row writes it with the arrow type double, so a null lands typed.

columns.name: tieout_tolerance_proposed_claim

A stated threshold_claims object may carry the key tieout_tolerance_proposed; when it does not, the writer states held for a non-null value and absent for a null one, never measured (a tie-out that has not been run, as for a source with no tie-out yet, reads absent).

rule24_record.i_mece_over_a_declared_domain: flow_convention -- domain: 'at what point in the day is a flow recognised'. END | START | MIDPOINT. All three are declared although only END is implemented, because DB-b-3's convention comparison exists to evaluate the other two and a value it may select must already be expressible; declaring them now is cheaper than a schema change mid-round. WHAT THIS COLUMN DOES NOT SAY, and the review's F11 is exactly this confusion: it reports the convention the arithmetic RAN under, never the one a comparison preferred nor the one a policy owner approved. method -- domain: 'which arithmetic family'. One member today. income_basis, fee_basis, day_count -- each one member today, each a closed set so a consumer can reject an unexpected value rather than parse free text.
rule24_record.ii_same_grain: Every column is a property of the METHOD VERSION. measured_at is the emission instant of this row, which is still a property of the version rather than of any account-day. There is no account or date column here by design: joining this table to a return row is done through method_version alone.
rule24_record.iii_intent_coherence: The table answers ONE question: what arithmetic produced the numbers that point at it. It deliberately carries no quality counts, no row totals and no per-account figures -- those are account-day facts and live on account_return_daily or in the round's deliverables. guard_substitution is the one apparent exception and is included under this axis deliberately: a withdrawn behaviour is part of the method's definition, and a consumer that cannot see the withdrawal cannot distinguish it from a behaviour never built.
rule24_record.iv_state_coherence: WHICH VALUES ONE REMEDY DOES NOT MOVE. Re-measuring the guard numbers moves tolerance, large_flow_share and comparability_max_excluded_weight together, because the ceiling is DERIVED from the first and the band; it moves neither the band itself (a PRD default) nor any convention column. DB-b-3 filling tieout_tolerance_proposed moves that column alone and must not touch the others. Implementing a different flow convention is NOT an update to flow_convention: it is a new method_version with its own partition and a recomputation of every return that pointed at the old one.
rule24_record.token_census: The five enum values that are not already ratified estate terms were introduced with this table at 0.1.0 and the producer is their only writer: TWR_DAILY_GEOMETRIC, cash_when_received, GROSS_ONLY, Account365, and the START/MIDPOINT members declared unused. The column name comparability_max_excluded_weight is new with PRD ruling 18 and appears in the PRD, this order and this producer only.
rule24_record.token_census_finding: NO COLLISION. Stated with its limit: this census is over the declared VALUES of a table minted by this round, so there is no prior consumer to collide with. That is a weaker claim than the account_return_daily 0.2.0 census, where an existing estate term could have clashed and the scans were run to check.

method_versions.flow_convention_basis: END is what the emitted returns were COMPUTED under, and it STAYS END. Amendment 3: a convention changes only by a new method_version with every return recomputed, never by writing a preferred convention into version 1. DB-3-AC2's counterexample set fails a row that names START over returns computed END, which is the defect this field exists to prevent.
method_versions.flow_convention_measured_winner_basis: The lowest median |opal - bd| of the three conventions over the five eligible periods, ties to END -- the rule executed faithfully. READ AS UNDETERMINED RATHER THAN MEASURED: END, START and MIDPOINT differ only on flow-bearing days, and of the 10 flow-bearing account-days across those periods exactly ONE survives into the eligible population, so START's margin of 0.000218941 is one day in one account. START and MIDPOINT are identical to nine decimals on all five periods. Row IRPT_DASHBD-S10.
method_versions.values_read_from: the LANDED parquet at irpt/49financial/gold/dim_return_method/method_version=1/data.parquet, not from the producer's source: these are the values a consumer actually receives.

method_versions.value_basis_note: The equity value basis: C-VALUE became the account's EQUITY, net_mv_plus_cash + margin_balance. Version 1 read net_mv_plus_cash alone. A change to the value basis is a change to the arithmetic, so it is a new method_version with every return recomputed, never an edit to version 1.
method_versions.values_read_from: the producer's source (data/assets/scripts/gold/irpt_reporting/account_return_daily.py, METHOD_VERSION and emit_method_row), NOT a landed parquet: method_version 2 is written by the P-2 packet, which re-reads the served row. The measured guard numbers (tolerance, large_flow_share, band, comparability_max_excluded_weight) are the thresholds file the packet passes and are not asserted here.

method_versions.flow_convention_basis: emit_method_row writes `winner or END` and no caller passes a winner, so the written value is END (account_return_daily.py).
method_versions.value_basis: POSITIONS-BASED EQUITY = account value rebuilt from positions at the entry's declared price_basis, plus the entry's declared cash
